name: free-router-desktop
description: Local model gateway and Pi coding agent
author: Neonity2020

scripts.cli:install: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix agent --omit=dev && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && node scripts/install-cli.cjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build --prefix frontend && cargo build --locked --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && electron .
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --prefix frontend && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && node desktop/prepare.cjs
